purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 374 Vijayawada (city code 10677); source registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: Government of Andhra Pradesh Survey, Settlements and Land Records Department; NTR District Administration
registryBasis: The official NTR District portal, whose headquarters is Vijayawada, directs residents to Andhra Pradesh land records; the Government of Andhra Pradesh Survey, Settlements and Land Records Department publishes BhuNaksha AP as cadastral mapping software. This verifies relevant local/state registry services but not parcel coverage at the WUP locator.

officialSources.observation: Official NTR District portal states that district headquarters is Vijayawada and provides the district-level administrative context.
Official NTR District land-records page directs users to the Andhra Pradesh land-records portal and identifies a Mee-Seva center in Vijayawada.

Government of Andhra Pradesh Survey, Settlements and Land Records portal identifies BhuNaksha as cadastral mapping software and describes geo-referenced spatial data. This does not establish an anonymous geometry endpoint or coverage at the target point.
Andhra Pradesh Space Applications Centre portal lists a state GIS and cadastral maps service; no Vijayawada parcel geometry response was obtained.

accessReview.reason: The public BhuNaksha landing page confirms the state cadastral mapping service, but the inspected public evidence does not establish a city-point query returning complete machine-readable georeferenced polygon features. No parcel selector, property record, owner data, or gated lookup was used.

requestEvidence.observation: Searches were conducted separately in English and the city/country primary language. Search results and official source pages are recorded above; search-result presence is not treated as a parcel response.
Inspected the listed official HTML/content sources only. No undocumented endpoint or feature response was observed, so no HTTP status, feature count, CRS or native feature ID is asserted.

NTR District public page directly fetched; its land-records page directs residents to the state land-records portal. No parcel map endpoint in the page HTML.
Public APSAC GIS dashboard links to a Cadastral Maps page and a separate cadastral-gis.php route; the latter returned 404.
Public cadastral page embeds ArcGIS Web AppBuilder app item ID `7e3b53a1a265421483fbcbb26c275834`.
Public app config points to webmap `b54a4a9a00b441a2bdd8f993d140edd5`; configured map extent is Web Mercator and does not coincide with the WUP locator.
Five published layers: one cached tiled cadastral map and four administrative layers. No feature layer, FeatureServer, or inline feature collection is present.
Anonymous service metadata request denied by nginx; no feature query or attribute request followed.

technicalBlocker: The official AP BhuNaksha HTTPS viewer path timed out on direct anonymous requests (Node and curl); HTTP also timed out. The official APSAC Cadastral Maps dashboard and public ArcGIS web-map metadata are reachable, but its AP cadastral map config contains only one cached tiled MapService layer plus administrative boundaries, no feature/vector layer. Its MapServer metadata path returns HTTP 403. No full georeferenced parcel polygon route was verified at the WUP locator.
sampleDisposition: No full polygon feature layer was present in the public APSAC cadastral webmap; BhuNaksha direct access timed out. Zero polygons retained.
remainingUncertainty: Urban Vijayawada coverage in the AP BhuNaksha viewer and the presence of an anonymous feature-geometry route remain unverified. A state viewer’s cadastral purpose alone does not verify complete geometry or availability for this exact city locator.
